reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a monitor or TV with a diagonal slash through it. While born as a UI toggle for 'stop screen sharing' or 'display off', in a personal task list it maps well to two distinct real-life task families: cutting down screen time (digital detox, screen-free rules) and dealing with a dead or disconnected monitor.
